citation.sourceDocument: 20 U.S.C. §§1087e(d)(7), 1087e(q), 1098e; Federal Student Aid, IDR Plan Request (OMB 1845-0102); Rev. Proc. 2025-32 §.29
citation.sourceNote: The un-park gate (SPEC-5-student-loans §4), read 2026-10-20. Each RAP parameter is checked in two places: the statute, 20 U.S.C. §1087e(q) on Cornell LII, and the Department's IDR Plan Request form (studentaid.gov/sites/default/files/IncomeDrivenRepayment-en-us.pdf, OMB 1845-0102, exp. 08/31/2029). Base payment of $120 at AGI not more than $10,000, then 1% to 10% of AGI in $10,000 tiers above $10,000, 10% above $100,000: agree. Base divided by 12, less $50 for each dependent: agree. $10 minimum monthly payment: agree. Unpaid interest not charged after an on-time payment (§1087e(q)(2)(A); the form: "for the life of the loan"): agree. Principal reduced by at least the lesser of $50 or the payment (§1087e(q)(2)(B)): agree. Cancellation after 360 qualifying payments (§1087e(q)(1)(D)-(E); the form: "360 qualifying monthly payments in not less than 30 years"): agree. The Tiered Standard plan's terms by total principal (§1087e(d)(7)(A)(i)(II)): 10 years under $25,000, 15 under $50,000, 20 under $100,000, 25 at $100,000 or more; the Department's form states only "between 10 and 25 years" by principal, which agrees as far as it goes. Income-based repayment (20 U.S.C. §1098e): 15% of AGI above 150% of the poverty line, 10% and 20 years for a new borrower on or after July 1, 2014 and before July 1, 2026, otherwise 25 years, and no more than the 10-year standard payment: agrees with the form. Rev. Proc. 2025-32 §.29: the §221 deduction of up to $2,500 phases out between $85,000 and $100,000 of MAGI ($175,000 and $205,000 joint) for 2026. 26 U.S.C. §127(a)(2): $5,250 of employer educational assistance, which §127(c)(1)(B) lets include payments on a qualified education loan. 26 U.S.C. §108(f)(5), as amended by Pub. L. 119-21 §70119 for discharges after December 31, 2025, now excludes only discharges on death or disability, so a balance forgiven under RAP or IBR is income under current law.
